{{Top|leg}}
'''Radiation shielding''' was a protective system that was used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]]<ref name="TT">{{WEGCite|story=The Trap (adventure scenario)|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref> and [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] all featured [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] shielding which was an improvement over the company's [[P2-series astromech droid]].<ref name="J7">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref> The shielding was also used to protect [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] components in transit since they could be damaged by exposure to radiation.<ref name="TT" />
